about: Sighting cards for the first hour after the slice, in W1's shape: 'line' is the header exactly as printed (KIND · WORK · VALUE); the rows are LAMP, WEAK and CARRIES and no others; 'read' is one plain sentence under the rows.

lamp.wary: WARY · it has turned its glass

cards.read: The island's own theodolite, walking its baseline once a year. This is the first of nine stations.
